messages:
alex: Heads up - dashboards showing EU aggregate counts are off for 2026-03-18 00:00-06:00. Spike in late events, looks like duplicates from the ingest path. I'm thinking a targeted recompute for affected shards instead of a full backfill. Anyone seen root cause yet?

maria: saw the alert. spike correlates with a retry storm from our kafka consumer pool around 00:45. logs show repeated ack failures -> duplicates. filing a db-electron ticket but we still need fixes for aggregates.

ravi: can we avoid recomputing everything? propose: 1) identify impacted shard list 2) run dedupe-only replay for those shards 3) canary recompute/shard aggregation then expand. cheaper and safer.

alex: +1. Maria, can you paste the shard list and sample event ids?

maria: paste: /dashboards/telemetry/agg-eu?range=2026-03-18
shards: sh-17, sh-18, sh-42, sh-99
sample ids: f1d2e3, a9b8c7

nick_sre: quota check - dedicated backfill queue has 3 free slots rn. We can bump to 6 if eng-platform OK with temporary quota reassign. Also recommend canary on sh-17 only.

sue_pm: what's the user impact? are customer dashboards wrong or internal only?

alex: internal + some customer-facing metrics that feed our SLAs (rolling daily counts). need to be conservative with notifications.

ravi: dedupe approach: run replay with --dedupe-only --id-hash=event_id --window=2026-03-18T00:00:00/2026-03-18T06:00 --shards=sh-17
Then run recompute agg job: recompute-agg --shard=sh-17 --window=... --canary

alex: example command for ops: 
```
replayctl start --shards=sh-17 --mode=canary --dedupe=true --window=2026-03-18T00:00:00/2026-03-18T06:00
```

replay-bot: replayctl queued job 43921 for sh-17 (mode=canary, dedupe=true). ETA start 10m.

nick_sre: I'll open 3 extra slots for 2h and set priority=50. If canary looks good, we can scale to full set.

maria: quick note - downstream join keys changed for a subset of events (old sdk v1.2 emitted null partner_id). dedupe may need to consider fallback key (user_id + timestamp). Ravi, can your dedupe handle that?

ravi: yes, we can run a two-pass dedupe: primary key=event_id, fallback=(user_id,timestamp). We'll run on canary first.

alex: important: telemetry alerts will keep firing while replay runs. I'll mute the specific alert rule for the 00:00-06:00 window and add a pinned note to the dashboard: "investigating late duplicates - canary recompute running".

console-bot: Alert suppression applied to rule agg-counts-eu for 2026-03-18 02:00 - 2026-03-18 06:30 by alex.

sue_pm: timeline and stakeholder comms? I don't want surprise emails to customers.

nick_sre: proposed timeline: canary start 22:30 UTC, verify within 30m, if <2% divergence expand to remaining shards, finish within 3h. I'll annotate the incident channel.

maria: will push a short post to #customer-metrics if >5% divergence and we need a correction window.

ravi: checklists for operator:
- ensure replay job has --idempotency=true
- set replay concurrency=1 for canary
- capture pre/post counts snapshot: 
  - pre: SELECT count_distinct(event_fingerprint) FROM agg WHERE shard=sh-17 AND dt='2026-03-18'
  - post: same query after recompute

alex: also remember to refresh cached dashboards / CDN invalidation for the same route. We have prefix caching on metrics endpoint.

frank_prod: product ask - can we surface a temporary "recompute priority" toggle in Console so non-SREs can promote backfill lanes without a support ticket? Not for this incident but noting.

alex: agreed - follow-up product ticket. For now we proceed with manual quota change.

replay-bot: canary job 43921 started on node gpu-05 at 2026-03-18T22:31:12Z

ravi: canary logs show dedupe pass completed, 1.8% reduction in duplicate rows on sh-17. running agg recompute now.

maria: monitoring looks stable so far. pre/post sample checks within 1.1% on key metrics.

nick_sre: expanding to remaining shards now. kicking off jobs for sh-18, sh-42, sh-99 with concurrency=2.

alex: final ops checklist: confirm idempotency tags on outputs, post backfill runbook entry, update dashboard note to "recompute complete - monitoring" and unmute alerts after 1h observation.

sue_pm: great. please loop me in on the postmortem and customer note draft.

replay-bot: backfill run completed for shards sh-17, sh-18, sh-42, sh-99. job ids: 43921,43922,43923,43924. Duration: 2h12m. No failures.

alex: thanks team. action items: (1) maria follow up with root-cause ticket on kafka acks (2) frank create product ticket for Console "recompute priority" toggle (3) nick confirm quota revert. I'll draft the incident note.

maria: filing root-cause ticket: RC-2026-321

frank_prod: created product task PROD-876: recompute-priority-toggle

nick_sre: quotas reverted to baseline.

alex: closing thread - will post the short incident note in #incidents after review.
